meaning:
ἀκροθίνιον, -ου, τό
(ἄκρος, θίς, a heap),
prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl.,
1. first-fruits (Xen.; MM, VGT, see word).
2. In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): Heb.7:4.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
